title: tenant.provision: the OTA worker creates tenant_<key>
caption: The platform asks, the OTA worker builds the schema in one transaction as velexis_provisioner and reports back (ota/docs/flows/tenant-provisioning-worker.md, src/provisioning). tenant.migrate, tenant.suspend and tenant.resume use the same queue.

steps.label: ota-tenant-ops tenant.provision {v, jobId, tenantId, requestedAt, requestId}
take job (concurrency 2); validate against @velexis/api-types/jobs (invalid → UnrecoverableError, queue.job_invalid)
tenant row: status must be provisioning (else TENANT_NOT_PROVISIONING), schema_name ^tenant_[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,39}$, time_zone
BEGIN; lock_timeout 5 s; advisory lock; CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS
GRANT USAGE + DML to velexis_ota_app; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES
seeds: storefront_settings (issue_after_payment, booking queue 50/0, time_zone), default markup rule 0 % priority 1000, notification_templates
platform-tenant-events tenant.provisioned {schemaName, schemaVersion, migrations[], steps[]} (id <jobId>-<attempt>)
steps.note: Retryable (lock timeout, serialization, connection lost): thrown back to BullMQ. Non-retryable (checksum mismatch, foreign content): tenant.provision_failed at once.

steps.label: consume: mirror ledger into platform.tenant_schema_migrations, post-steps, activate
